description: Deterministic PII/secret detector cases. All values are synthetic test data: example.com/.org domains (RFC 2606), Ofcom drama-range UK numbers, the standard Visa test PAN, and the published IBAN example. 'expected' lists the types that must be detected; 'masked' is the exact expected output of mask(). An empty expected list means NO detection (false-positive guard).
placeholder_format: [<TYPE>_<n>] where n counts per type within one text, starting at 1

cases.text: My email is jane.doe@example.com, please reply there.
cases.masked: My email is [EMAIL_1], please reply there.

cases.text: My card is 4111 1111 1111 1111 and it was charged twice.
cases.masked: My card is [CARD_NUMBER_1] and it was charged twice.

cases.note: 16 digits but fails the Luhn check, so it is not a card number.

cases.text: Send it to IBAN GB82 WEST 1234 5698 7654 32 please.
My password is Summer2026! - can you log in for me?
cases.masked: My password is [CREDENTIAL_1] - can you log in for me?

cases.text: the code is 482913, I just got it by SMS
cases.masked: the code is [CREDENTIAL_1], I just got it by SMS

cases.text: I changed my password this morning but login fails.
cases.masked: I changed my password this morning but login fails.
cases.note: Mentions 'password' without disclosing one; must not be flagged.
Order IDs, dates and amounts are NOT PII.

cases.text: Error 503 since 09:00 UTC on the dashboard.
cases.masked: Error 503 since 09:00 UTC on the dashboard.
cases.note: Error codes and times are not phone numbers.

cases.text: Mi correo es ana.garcia@example.com y mi contraseña es Clave#123
cases.masked: Mi correo es [EMAIL_1] y mi contraseña es [CREDENTIAL_1]

cases.text: Please never share your password with anyone.
cases.masked: Please never share your password with anyone.
cases.note: Advice text (as found in KB/drafts) must not be flagged.

restore_roundtrip: unmask(mask(text)) must equal the original text for every case; mask() must be idempotent: mask(mask(text)) == mask(text).
